decision: Selected the official NRW building-address point (Geobasis NRW INSPIRE addresses from building references) for Albertstraße 27, 40233 Düsseldorf (Address_DENW20AL0000trho), the address Equinix publishes for DU1, transformed from EPSG:25832 to WGS84, as the project locator. The coordinate in the map widget on Equinix's page was not used.

selected_properties.source_layer: ad:Address (INSPIRE-WFS NW Adressen Gebäudereferenzen, Geobasis NRW)
selected_properties.house_number: 27 (published in the second LocatorDesignator, whose type code reads addressNumberExtension; the first designator, typed addressNumber, is empty; for 27a the letter sits in the first designator, so the service swaps the two type codes)
selected_properties.operator_published_address: Albertstrasse 27, 40233 Dusseldorf (Equinix DU1 page, Internet Archive copy of 3 October 2026)

consistency_checks.bbox_query: A BBOX query of 400 m x 400 m (EPSG:25832 346635-347035 / 5676325-5676725) returns 57 address features, eight of them on Albertstraße (ThoroughfareName_0511100001024): 27, 27a, 30, 31, 32, 36, 39 and 40. A separate thoroughfare-name query for Albertstraße returns 33 streets in NRW, one of them in Düsseldorf (0511100001024).
consistency_checks.crs: The response declares srsName http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/epsg/0/25832 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N).

transform_check: pyproj 3.7.1 (PROJ 9.5.1) EPSG:25832 -> EPSG:4326, always_xy; rounded to 7 decimal places; the rounded point transforms back to within 0.006 m.

excluded_coordinates.kind: Map widget coordinate on the Equinix DU1 page
excluded_coordinates.reason: A map-embed parameter, which the locator policy excludes; not read or used.

limitations: The point is the state register building-address point for the published address (specification building, method byAdministrator); it is not a parcel, building footprint or surveyed position, and the service states no positional accuracy.
